name: Zhou Daguan at Angkor
summary: A member of a Yuan embassy spends a year at Angkor, capital of the Khmer empire at its height, and writes the only eyewitness account of daily life there: the gilded towers, the king's processions, the markets kept by women, the bathing in the lake and the Chinese settlers who had married Khmer wives.

stops.note: The embassy sails in early spring.
Up the river toward the great lake.
A year in the Khmer capital.
